transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is that I'm having a lot of trouble just... staying in my chair when I really need to. Like, during our sprint planning meetings at work, or even when I was on the phone with the bank about my mortgage recently, I just keep getting up. I know I should stay put, but it's like I suddenly decide I need a glass of water right that second, or I need to go check something in the other room. It's just getting really frustrating.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or wired for several days in a row?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm pretty much always a little restless, like I mentioned, but I've never had a stretch of days where I felt unusually wired or anything like that. It's just my normal, everyday level of energy.
When you get up during those situations, is it because you feel driven to do something specific to relieve a thought that won’t leave your mind?

Um, no, it's not really like that. I don't have a specific thought stuck in my head that I'm trying to get rid of or anything. It's honestly just... more of a physical feeling. Like my body just can't sit there anymore. 

So I'll suddenly think, oh, I should get water, almost just as an excuse to move around. It's not driven by a thought that won't leave me alone, it's really just a sudden urge to get out of the chair.
When you feel that urge to get up, do you also feel anxious right then?

No, not really. Um, I wouldn't call it anxiety. I'm not worried or stressed about anything in that moment, it's just... my body wanting to move. So, no, no anxious feelings, just that physical restlessness.
Did you have this same kind of hard-to-stay-seated restlessness when you were a child?

Yes, actually. Um, I remember my teachers back in elementary school having to move my desk, or they were constantly reminding me to just stay in my seat. I was always popping up. And I'd end up talking before I was called on, or just... rushing through my assignments even when I understood the work perfectly fine. So, yeah, it's definitely been around since I was a kid.
